scope: Review only the V2 phonotactic/authoring profile assembled from approved B1-B5 decisions and Sprint A corpus audit. Do not assign word-specific stress, new romanizations, morphology, semantics, grammar, productivity or curriculum state.
inputs: B1 approved G40=/y/ vowel distinct from G16=/j/
B2 approved adjacent vowels including VVV
B3 approved distinct vowel nuclei by default and no automatic y->j glide
B4 approved lexically marked stress with no global default
B5 approved dual-layer romanization: 20 governed human mappings + 40/40 G-ID fallback
Sprint A A2 recomputed strict (CV)+(C)? fit as 26/33 under authoritative phoneme classes
key_profile_changes_from_v1: Replace orthography-sensitive 30/33 with phoneme-classified 26/33 for strict (CV)+(C)? fit.
Treat CV-rich shapes as an optional authoring preference, not a language law.
Remove blanket avoid-hiatus recommendation as a canonical/authoring default because FROZEN evidence includes VVV.
Allow adjacent vowels and preserve distinct nuclei by default.
Keep TS/G30 atomic, final consonants allowed, bridge forms separate and collision checks mandatory.
Keep initial-vowel and internal-cluster shapes case-by-case rather than categorically banned.
Separate corpus facts, governed language rules and authoring preferences into explicit layers.

options.effect: Adopt V2 as the current governed phonotactic/authoring profile; mark V1 HISTORICAL_PRIOR without deleting it. No new word-level stress, romanization, semantics, morphology, grammar or curriculum changes occur.
Keep V1 only as historical prior and hold new authoring profile activation until revisions are reviewed.
